001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity;
002
003import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
004import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
005import androidx.room.ColumnInfo;
006import androidx.room.Entity;
007import androidx.room.ForeignKey;
008import androidx.room.Index;
009import androidx.room.PrimaryKey;
010
011/**
012 * Represents a track object that is mapped to a database entity.
013 * Tracks are associated with a user and include attributes such as
014 * an auto-generated primary key, a name, and a foreign key linking to the user.
015 *
016 * Annotations are used to define this entity for database purposes:
017 * - {@link Entity} specifies the database table name, indices, and foreign key constraints.
018 * - {@link PrimaryKey} and {@link ColumnInfo} define properties of table columns.
019 * - {@link ForeignKey} establishes a relationship with the {@link User} entity.
020 *
021 * The `Track` class overrides `toString` for convenient representation,
022 * and overrides `equals` and `hashCode` for consistency when comparing and hashing.
023 *
024 * Features:
025 * - Tracks are uniquely identified by their `id`.
026 * - A name must be provided and cannot be null.
027 * - Tracks are associated with a user through the `userId` foreign key.
028 */
029@Entity(
030    tableName = "track",
031    indices = {
032        @Index({"user_id", "name"})
033    },
034    foreignKeys = {
035        @ForeignKey(entity = User.class, parentColumns = "user_id", childColumns = "user_id", onDelete = ForeignKey.CASCADE)
036    }
037)
038public class Track {
039
040  /**
041   * Represents the unique identifier for a {@code Track} entity in the database.
042   * This field is marked as the primary key and is auto-generated upon insertion
043   * of a new {@code Track} record. It is mapped to the "track_id" column
044   * in the underlying SQLite table.
045   */
046  @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true)
047  @ColumnInfo(name = "track_id")
048  private long id;
049
050  /**
051   * Represents the name of the {@code Track} entity. This field is annotated with {@link NonNull},
052   * ensuring that it cannot be null at any time. It is initialized to an empty string by default.
053   *
054   * The `name` field serves as an identifier for the track entity's logical grouping,
055   * distinct from its unique database identifier (`id`). It must be explicitly set when
056   * creating or updating a `Track` instance.
057   */
058  @NonNull
059  private String name = "";
060
061  /**
062   * Represents a foreign key linking a {@code Track} entity to a {@code User} entity.
063   * This field is mapped to the "user_id" column in the database table and is indexed
064   * for optimized query performance. The {@code userId} field is used to establish
065   * the association between tracks and their corresponding user in the database.
066   */
067  @ColumnInfo(name = "user_id", index = true)
068  private long userId;
069
070  public long getId() {
071    return id;
072  }
073
074  public void setId(long id) {
075    this.id = id;
076  }
077
078  @NonNull
079  public String getName() {
080    return name;
081  }
082
083  public void setName(@NonNull String name) {
084    this.name = name;
085  }
086
087  public long getUserId() {
088    return userId;
089  }
090
091  public void setUserId(long userId) {
092    this.userId = userId;
093  }
094
095  @NonNull
096  @Override
097  public String toString() {
098    return name;
099  }
100
101  @Override
102  public int hashCode() {
103    return Long.hashCode(id);
104  }
105
106  @Override
107  public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
108    boolean result;
109    if (this == obj) {
110      result = true;
111    } else if (obj instanceof Track other) {
112      result = id !=0 && id == other.id;
113    } else {
114      result = false;
115    }
116    return result;
117  }
118}
